description: This file defines a GraySwanGuardrail class that integrates Gray Swan's Cygnal monitoring API into a guardrail system for language model outputs. It includes methods for applying guardrails, handling API responses, and formatting violation messages, with support for different violation actions and modes.

classes.name: GraySwanGuardrailMissingSecrets
classes.description: Exception raised when the Gray Swan API key is missing.

classes.name: GraySwanGuardrailAPIError
classes.description: Exception raised when the Gray Swan API returns an error.

classes.name: GraySwanGuardrail
classes.description: A guardrail class that integrates Gray Swan's Cygnal monitoring API, providing methods to apply guardrails, handle API responses, and format violation messages, supporting different violation actions and modes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GraySwanGuardrail instance, setting API configuration, logging, and supported event hooks.

methods.name: should_run_guardrail
methods.description: Overrides to add debug logging for guardrail execution decision.

methods.name: apply_guardrail
methods.description: Main method to apply the guardrail to input texts, calling Gray Swan API and processing responses.

methods.name: run_grayswan_guardrail
methods.description: Legacy method for testing the guardrail on a payload.

methods.name: _process_grayswan_response
methods.description: Processes the API response for backward compatibility, raising exceptions or modifying inputs based on violations.

methods.name: _call_grayswan_api
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous call to the Gray Swan API with the provided payload.

methods.name: _process_response_internal
methods.description: Handles the API response, raising exceptions or modifying inputs based on violation severity and configured actions.

methods.name: _prepare_headers
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers for API requests, including authorization.

methods.name: _prepare_payload
methods.description: Constructs the API request payload from messages and dynamic parameters.

methods.name: _format_violation_message
methods.description: Formats a user-friendly message describing the violation details.

methods.name: _format_violated_rules
methods.description: Formats a list of violated rules into a readable string.

methods.name: _resolve_threshold
methods.description: Resolves the violation threshold from parameter or environment variable.

methods.name: _resolve_reasoning_mode
methods.description: Resolves the reasoning mode from parameter or environment variable.
